sanskrit: aṣṭau babhūvur vīrasya tasyāmātyā yaśasvinaḥ śucayaś cānuraktāś ca rājakṛtyeṣu nityaśaḥ
english: That heroic king had eight ministers, men of renown, pure of conduct and devoted, ever constant in their royal duties.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭir jayanto vijayaḥ siddhārtho arthasādhakaḥ aśoko mantrapālaś ca sumantraś cāṣṭamo 'bhavat
english: Dhṛṣṭi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhārtha, Arthasādhaka, Aśoka, Mantrapāla — and Sumantra was the eighth.

sanskrit: ṛtvijau dvāv abhimatau tasyāstām ṛṣisattamau vasiṣṭho vāmadevaś ca mantriṇaś ca tathāpare
english: He had two highly esteemed officiating priests, both foremost among sages — Vasiṣṭha and Vāmadeva — and other counsellors as well.

sanskrit: śrīmantaś ca mahātmānaḥ śāstrajñā dṛḍhavikramāḥ kīrtimantaḥ praṇihitā yathāvacanakāriṇaḥ
english: They were prosperous, great-souled, learned in the śāstras, firm in valour, of established fame, ever attentive and obedient to command.

sanskrit: tejaḥkṣamāyaśaḥprāptāḥ smitapūrvābhibhāṣiṇaḥ krodhāt kāmārthahetor vā na brūyur anṛtaṃ vacaḥ
english: Endowed with splendour, forbearance, and fame, they spoke always with a smile preceding their words; neither from anger nor from desire of gain would they utter a falsehood.

sanskrit: teṣām aviditaṃ kiṃ cit sveṣu nāsti pareṣu vā kriyamāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ vāpi cāreṇāpi cikīrṣitam
english: Nothing was unknown to them, whether among their own people or among foreigners — whether an act being done, already done, or merely intended — not even through the work of spies.

sanskrit: kuśalā vyavahāreṣu sauhṛdeṣu parīkṣitāḥ prāptakālaṃ yathā daṇḍaṃ dhārayeyuḥ suteṣv api
english: Skilled in affairs of state, tested in matters of friendship, they would apply punishment proportionate to the occasion — even upon their own sons if need be.

sanskrit: kośasaṃgrahaṇe yuktā balasya ca parigrahe ahitaṃ cāpi puruṣaṃ na vihiṃsyur adūṣakam
english: Diligent in the accumulation of the treasury and in the maintenance of the army, they would not injure even an enemy who was guilty of no actual offence.

sanskrit: vīrāś ca niyatotsāhā rājaśāstram anuṣṭhitāḥ śucīnāṃ rakṣitāraś ca nityaṃ viṣayavāsinām
english: Valiant and of steady vigour, disciplined in the science of kingship, they were ever the protectors of the virtuous inhabitants throughout the realm.

sanskrit: brahmakṣatram ahiṃsantas te kośaṃ samapūrayan sutīkṣṇadaṇḍāḥ saṃprekṣya puruṣasya balābalam
english: Without harming the brāhmaṇa or kṣatriya classes, inflicting sharp punishment only after carefully assessing a man's strength and weakness, they filled the royal treasury.

sanskrit: śucīnām ekabuddhīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃprajānatām nāsīt pure vā rāṣṭre vā mṛṣāvādī naraḥ kva cit
english: Among all those who were pure, united in mind, and fully wise, there was not a single man given to falsehood anywhere in the city or in the realm.

sanskrit: kaś cin na duṣṭas tatrāsīt paradāraratir naraḥ praśāntaṃ sarvam evāsīd rāṣṭraṃ puravaraṃ ca tat
english: There was none wicked there, no man addicted to another's wife; that realm and that finest of cities were utterly at peace.

sanskrit: suvāsasaḥ suveśāś ca te ca sarve suśīlinaḥ hitārthaṃ ca narendrasya jāgrato nayacakṣuṣā
english: Well-robed and well-attired, all of them were of fine character, ever watchful with the eye of wise counsel for the welfare of the lord of men.

sanskrit: gurau guṇagṛhītāś ca prakhyātāś ca parākramaiḥ videśeṣv api vijñātāḥ sarvato buddhiniścayāt
english: Won over to their preceptor by his virtues, celebrated for their own valour, known even in foreign lands for their all-round firmness of judgment.

sanskrit: īdṛśais tair amātyais tu rājā daśaratho 'naghaḥ upapanno guṇopetair anvaśāsad vasuṃdharām
english: Endowed with such ministers, men possessed of every excellence, the sinless king Daśaratha governed the earth.

sanskrit: avekṣamāṇaś cāreṇa prajā dharmeṇa rañjayan nādhyagacchad viśiṣṭaṃ vā tulyaṃ vā śatrum ātmanaḥ
english: Surveying his subjects through his spies and delighting them with righteous rule, he could find no enemy equal to him, let alone superior.

sanskrit: tair mantribhir mantrahitair niviṣṭair vṛto 'nuraktaiḥ kuśalaiḥ samarthaiḥ sa pārthivo dīptim avāpa yuktas tejomayair gobhir ivodito 'rkaḥ
english: Surrounded by those counsellors — versed in deliberation, dedicated, devoted, skilled, and capable — that sovereign blazed with glory, like the risen sun encircled by its effulgent rays.

sanskrit: tasya tv evaṃ prabhāvasya dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ sutārthaṃ tapyamānasya nāsīd vaṃśakaraḥ sutaḥ
english: Yet for him — of such great power, knowing righteousness, great-souled — who yearned ardently for a son, there was no son to continue the lineage.

sanskrit: cintayānasya tasyaivaṃ buddhir āsīn mahātmanaḥ sutārthaṃ vājimedhena kimarthaṃ na yajāmy aham
english: As he pondered thus, the thought arose in the mind of that great soul: 'Why do I not perform the Aśvamedha sacrifice to obtain a son?'

sanskrit: sa niścitāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā yaṣṭavyam iti buddhimān mantribhiḥ saha dharmātmā sarvair eva kṛtātmabhiḥ
english: Having resolved with certainty that the sacrifice must be performed, that wise, righteous-souled king, together with all his well-disciplined ministers —

sanskrit: tato 'bravīd idaṃ rājā sumantraṃ mantrisattamam śīghram ānaya me sarvān gurūṃs tān sapurohitān
english: — then spoke to Sumantra, best of ministers: 'Quickly bring to me all those venerable preceptors together with the chief priest.'

sanskrit: etac chrutvā rahaḥ sūto rājānam idam abravīt ṛtvigbhir upadiṣṭo 'yaṃ purāvṛtto mayā śrutaḥ
english: Having heard this, the charioteer Sumantra addressed the king privately: 'There is an account, formerly heard by me, related by the officiating priests —'

sanskrit: sanatkumāro bhagavān pūrvaṃ kathitavān kathām ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃnidhau rājaṃs tava putrāgamaṃ prati
english: '— the blessed Sanatkumāra once narrated a tale in the presence of sages, O king, concerning the coming of sons to you.'

sanskrit: kāśyapasya tu putro 'sti vibhāṇḍaka iti śrutaḥ ṛśyaśṛṅga iti khyātas tasya putro bhaviṣyati
english: 'Kaśyapa has a son known as Vibhāṇḍaka; his son in turn shall be renowned as Ṛśyaśṛṅga.'

sanskrit: sa vane nityasaṃvṛddho munir vanacaraḥ sadā nānyaṃ jānāti viprendro nityaṃ pitranuvartanāt
english: 'Always raised in the forest, that sage ever roams the woods; that foremost of brāhmaṇas knows nothing else, being perpetually devoted to attendance upon his father.'

sanskrit: dvaividhyaṃ brahmacaryasya bhaviṣyati mahātmanaḥ lokeṣu prathitaṃ rājan vipraiś ca kathitaṃ sadā
english: 'The twofold nature of that great soul's celibate life shall be proclaimed throughout the worlds, O king, and ever spoken of by brāhmaṇas.'

sanskrit: tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kālaḥ samabhivartata agniṃ śuśrūṣamāṇasya pitaraṃ ca yaśasvinam
english: 'As he lives thus — tending the sacred fire and serving his illustrious father — time passes on.'

sanskrit: etasminn eva kāle tu lomapādaḥ pratāpavān aṅgeṣu prathito rājā bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ
english: 'At this very time, the mighty Lomapāda, a king of great prowess, shall be celebrated in the Aṅga realm.'

sanskrit: tasya vyatikramād rājño bhaviṣyati sudāruṇā anāvṛṣṭiḥ sughorā vai sarvabhūtabhayāvahā
english: 'On account of a transgression by that king, a terrible, exceedingly dreadful drought shall come — bringing fear to all living beings.'

sanskrit: anāvṛṣṭyāṃ tu vṛttāyāṃ rājā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ brāhmaṇāñ śrutavṛddhāṃś ca samānīya pravakṣyati
english: 'When the drought has come to pass, the king, filled with distress, will summon brāhmaṇas of learning and seniority and will speak.'

sanskrit: bhavantaḥ śrutadharmāṇo lokacāritravedinaḥ samādiśantu niyamaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathā bhavet
english: '"You are versed in sacred law and knowers of the ways of the world — prescribe for me the observance by which an expiation may come about."'

sanskrit: vakṣyanti te mahīpālaṃ brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ vibhāṇḍakasutaṃ rājan sarvopāyair ihānaya
english: 'Those brāhmaṇas, masters of the Veda, will tell the king: "O king, bring here by every means the son of Vibhāṇḍaka."'

sanskrit: ānāyya ca mahīpāla ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ susatkṛtam prayaccha kanyāṃ śāntāṃ vai vidhinā susamāhitaḥ
english: '"And having brought Ṛśyaśṛṅga, duly honoured, O lord of the earth, give him your daughter Śāntā according to prescribed rite, with a collected mind."'

sanskrit: teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā cintāṃ prapatsyate kenopāyena vai śakyam ihānetuṃ sa vīryavān
english: 'On hearing their words, the king will fall into anxious deliberation: "By what means is it possible to bring here that one of great might?"'

sanskrit: tato rājā viniścitya saha mantribhir ātmavān purohitam amātyāṃś ca preṣayiṣyati satkṛtān
english: 'Then that self-composed king, having resolved after deliberation with his ministers, will despatch his chief priest and his councillors with due honours.'

sanskrit: te tu rājño vacaḥ śrutvā vyathitā vanatānanāḥ na gacchema ṛṣer bhītā anuneṣyanti taṃ nṛpam
english: 'But they, on hearing the king's command, will be distressed, their faces downcast, and — afraid of the sage — will plead with the king that they cannot go.'

sanskrit: vakṣyanti cintayitvā te tasyopāyāṃś ca tān kṣamān āneṣyāmo vayaṃ vipraṃ na ca doṣo bhaviṣyati
english: 'Yet after reflection they will propose means fit for the task: "We shall bring the brāhmaṇa here — and no blame shall fall upon us."'

sanskrit: evam aṅgādhipenaiva gaṇikābhir ṛṣeḥ sutaḥ ānīto 'varṣayad devaḥ śāntā cāsmai pradīyate
english: 'Thus, by the lord of the Aṅgas himself, through the agency of courtesans, the sage's son was brought — and the god rained; and Śāntā was given to him.'

sanskrit: ṛśyaśṛṅgas tu jāmātā putrāṃs tava vidhāsyati sanatkumārakathitam etāvad vyāhṛtaṃ mayā
english: 'And Ṛśyaśṛṅga as your son-in-law shall procure sons for you — this much has been declared by Sanatkumāra's account, as related by me.'

sanskrit: atha hṛṣṭo daśarathaḥ sumantraṃ pratyabhāṣata yatharṣyaśṛṅgas tv ānīto vistareṇa tvayocyatām
english: Then Daśaratha, overjoyed, replied to Sumantra: 'Tell me now in full detail how Ṛśyaśṛṅga was brought here.'

sanskrit: sumantraś codito rājñā provācedaṃ vacas tadā yatharṣyaśṛṅgas tv ānītaḥ śṛṇu me mantribhiḥ saha
english: Sumantra, prompted by the king, then spoke these words: 'Hear from me, together with your ministers, how Ṛśyaśṛṅga was brought.'

sanskrit: lomapādam uvācedaṃ sahāmātyaḥ purohitaḥ upāyo nirapāyo 'yam asmābhir abhicintitaḥ
english: 'The chief priest, together with the councillors, spoke thus to Lomapāda: "A stratagem free of risk has been devised by us."'

sanskrit: ṛśyaśṛṅgo vanacaras tapaḥsvādhyāyane rataḥ anabhijñaḥ sa nārīṇāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ sukhasya ca
english: '"Ṛśyaśṛṅga is a forest-dweller, devoted to austerity and Vedic recitation; he is ignorant of women, of sense pleasures, and of enjoyment."'

sanskrit: indriyārthair abhimatair naracittapramāthibhiḥ puram ānāyayiṣyāmaḥ kṣipraṃ cādhyavasīyatām
english: '"By means of the objects of the senses that are pleasing and that overthrow the minds of men, we shall quickly bring him to the city — let it be decided upon."'

sanskrit: gaṇikās tatra gacchantu rūpavatyaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ pralobhya vividhopāyair āneṣyantīha satkṛtāḥ
english: '"Let courtesans, beautiful and well-adorned, go there; by enticing him through various means, they shall bring him here, treated with honour."'

sanskrit: śrutvā tatheti rājā ca pratyuvāca purohitam purohito mantriṇaś ca tathā cakruś ca te tadā
english: 'Hearing this, the king consented and replied to the chief priest; and the chief priest and the ministers did accordingly at that time.'

sanskrit: vāramukhyās tu tac chrutvā vanaṃ praviviśur mahat āśramasyāvidūre 'smin yatnaṃ kurvanti darśane ṛṣiputrasya ghorasya nityam āśramavāsinaḥ
english: 'The leading courtesans, having heard this, entered the great forest; not far from that hermitage they made every effort to obtain a sight of the awesome sage's son who always dwelt in the āśrama.'

sanskrit: pituḥ sa nityasaṃtuṣṭo nāticakrāma cāśramāt
english: 'He, ever contented in the service of his father, did not stray far from the hermitage.'

sanskrit: na tena janmaprabhṛti dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tapasvinā strī vā pumān vā yac cānyat sattvaṃ nagararāṣṭrajam
english: 'From birth that ascetic had never previously seen a woman, a man, or any other creature belonging to city or country.'

sanskrit: tataḥ kadā cit taṃ deśam ājagāma yadṛcchayā vibhāṇḍakasutas tatra tāś cāpaśyad varāṅganāḥ
english: 'Then one day Vibhāṇḍaka's son came to that spot by chance, and there he saw those lovely women.'

sanskrit: tāś citraveṣāḥ pramadā gāyantyo madhurasvaraiḥ ṛṣiputram upāgamya sarvā vacanam abruvan
english: 'Those women, wondrously attired, singing in sweet voices, approached the sage's son and all spoke to him.'

sanskrit: kas tvaṃ kiṃ vartase brahmañ jñātum icchāmahe vayam ekas tvaṃ vijane ghore vane carasi śaṃsa naḥ
english: '"Who are you, O brāhmaṇa, and how do you fare? We wish to know. Tell us why you wander alone in this desolate, fearsome forest."'

sanskrit: adṛṣṭarūpās tās tena kāmyarūpā vane striyaḥ hārdāt tasya matir jātā ākhyātuṃ pitaraṃ svakam
english: 'Those women of beautiful form, never seen before by him in the forest, stirred his heart, and the inclination arose in him to tell of his own father.'

sanskrit: pitā vibhāṇḍako 'smākaṃ tasyāhaṃ suta aurasaḥ ṛśyaśṛṅga iti khyātaṃ nāma karma ca me bhuvi
english: '"My father is Vibhāṇḍaka; I am his own-begotten son. The name by which I am known upon the earth, and my calling as well, is Ṛśyaśṛṅga."'

sanskrit: ihāśramapado 'smākaṃ samīpe śubhadarśanāḥ kariṣye vo 'tra pūjāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ vidhipūrvakam
english: '"Our hermitage is close at hand — O you of auspicious appearance, I shall offer all of you honour there according to the prescribed rite."'

sanskrit: ṛṣiputravacaḥ śrutvā sarvāsāṃ matir āsa vai tad āśramapadaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagmuḥ sarvāś ca tena ha
english: 'On hearing the sage's son's words, all of them were disposed to see that hermitage, and all went there with him.'

sanskrit: gatānāṃ tu tataḥ pūjām ṛṣiputraś cakāra ha idam arghyam idaṃ pādyam idaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ ca naḥ
english: 'And when they had arrived, the sage's son performed the rite of hospitality: "Here is the arghya water, here the water for the feet, here are the roots and fruits of our āśrama."'

sanskrit: pratigṛhya tu tāṃ pūjāṃ sarvā eva samutsukāḥ ṛṣer bhītāś ca śīghraṃ tu gamanāya matiṃ dadhuḥ
english: 'Having received that hospitality, all of them — eager and also afraid of the sage — quickly resolved to depart.'

sanskrit: asmākam api mukhyāni phalānīmāni vai dvija gṛhāṇa prati bhadraṃ te bhakṣayasva ca mā ciram
english: '"Take these choice fruits of ours too, O brāhmaṇa — good fortune to you; eat them, and do not delay."'

sanskrit: tatas tās taṃ samāliṅgya sarvā harṣasamanvitāḥ modakān pradadus tasmai bhakṣyāṃś ca vividhāñ śubhān
english: 'Then all of them, filled with delight, embraced him and gave him sweetmeats and various beautiful confections to eat.'

sanskrit: tāni cāsvādya tejasvī phalānīti sma manyate anāsvāditapūrvāṇi vane nityanivāsinā
english: 'The radiant youth tasted them and took them for fruits — things never tasted before by one who had always lived in the forest.'

sanskrit: āpṛcchya ca tadā vipraṃ vratacaryāṃ nivedya ca gacchanti smāpadeśāt tā bhītās tasya pituḥ striyaḥ
english: 'Then, having taken leave of the brāhmaṇa and pleading their vows of observance, those women departed from that place, afraid of his father.'

sanskrit: gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu kāśyapasyātmajo dvijaḥ asvasthahṛdayaś cāsīd duḥkhaṃ sma parivartate
english: 'When all of them had gone, the brāhmaṇa son of Kaśyapa was ill at ease in his heart and tossed about in anguish.'

sanskrit: tato 'paredyus taṃ deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ
english: 'On the very next day that man of great power went back to the place where he had seen those charming, well-adorned leading courtesans.'

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvaiva ca tadā vipram āyāntaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ upasṛtya tataḥ sarvās tās tam ūcur idaṃ vacaḥ
english: 'And seeing the brāhmaṇa approaching, all of them, their minds delighted, drew near and spoke these words to him.'

sanskrit: ehy āśramapadaṃ saumya asmākam iti cābruvan tatrāpy eṣa vidhiḥ śrīmān viśeṣeṣa bhaviṣyati
english: '"Come, gentle one, to our hermitage" — so they said to him — "there too this auspicious hospitality shall be offered, and more besides."'

sanskrit: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ hṛdayaṃgamam gamanāya matiṃ cakre taṃ ca ninyus tadā striyaḥ
english: 'On hearing the heart-captivating words of all of them, he resolved to go; and the women then led him away.'

sanskrit: tatra cānīyamāne tu vipre tasmin mahātmani vavarṣa sahasā devo jagat prahlādayaṃs tadā
english: 'And as that great-souled brāhmaṇa was being brought there, the god suddenly rained down, gladdening the world at that moment.'

sanskrit: varṣeṇaivāgataṃ vipraṃ viṣayaṃ svaṃ narādhipaḥ pratyudgamya muniṃ prahvaḥ śirasā ca mahīṃ gataḥ
english: 'The lord of men went forth to meet the brāhmaṇa who had arrived with the very rains into his own realm; bowing humbly, the king touched the earth with his head before the sage.'

sanskrit: arghyaṃ ca pradadau tasmai nyāyataḥ susamāhitaḥ vavre prasādaṃ viprendrān mā vipraṃ manyur āviśet
english: 'He duly offered him the arghya with a composed and collected mind, and begged grace of that foremost of brāhmaṇas, that no anger should enter the brāhmaṇa's heart.'

sanskrit: antaḥpuraṃ praviśyāsmai kanyāṃ dattvā yathāvidhi śāntāṃ śāntena manasā rājā harṣam avāpa saḥ
english: 'Having led him into the inner apartments, and given him his daughter Śāntā according to prescribed rite, the king — his mind serene — was filled with joy.'

sanskrit: evaṃ sa nyavasat tatra sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ ṛśyaśṛṅgo mahātejāḥ śāntayā saha bhāryayā
english: 'Thus Ṛśyaśṛṅga of great radiance dwelt there, honoured with every desired thing, together with his wife Śāntā.'
